title: Mary Jane Veloso’s case: From death row to freedom
summary: Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo lays out the timeline of events surrounding Veloso's case

blocks.text: Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo lays out the timeline of events surrounding Veloso's case
MANILA, Philippines – Former overseas Filipino worker Mary Jane Veloso has been pardoned by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., paving the way for her freedom after over 15 years in prison.
But what are the events that led to her arrest, near-execution, pardon, and eventually, release from prison?
Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo lays out the timeline of events, following Veloso’s release on Friday, September 25. – Rappler.com
Reporter, writer, producer, video editor: Jairo BolledoSupervising editor: Mia Gonzalez
